production_review: Only the U16 eligibility arm drops its q-word OR reduction; the comment changes accordingly. Independently reversing those two regions recovers the entire original production prefix byte-for-byte. I16, F32, exact scale bits, initial/inactive guards and upload/write/sync code are unchanged.

Actual decode_u16 uses k=scale/65535.0 followed by exact finite nonnegative u16-to-f32 conversion times k. Scale bits0 therefore imply exact positive-zero decoded words for every u16. Negative-zero/nonzero/nonfinite scales remain ineligible; signed-q logic remains conservative and unchanged.

No host quant/scales are rewritten. This is required because solved_strategy_into normalizes U16 q directly without scale. Device layout/size, capacity admission, saved representation and constructor ownership remain unchanged; subsequent original write/readback paths still operate on the same decoded image.
written_test_review: New test explicitly calls the actual decode_u16 on the inclusive0..=65535 range, poisons outputs with NaN first and checks every output bit pattern equals0. It populates a real U16 Store with those quants, checks both predicate layout flags and both snapshot indices, and verifies host q/scales are preserved. The corrected usize-to-u64 length is lossless for65536 and matches the Store factory signature.

Existing signed rejection values1,-1,MIN,MAX, F32 rejection and nonpositive-zero/nonfinite scale cases are retained. Existing reused-snapshot assertions are extended to U16. Four local tests become five; prospective E020 GPU-only85/4 is conditional on the eventual baseline and not an executed result.
These are decode/predicate checks, not GPU upload evidence. No independent native full/compact upload test is present.
future_control_review: The proposed one-small-Spot original-versus-candidate comparison is proportionate: require actual full and compact-with-inactive geometry, identical initial nonzero q/+0 scale, exact raw GPU arrays, host q/scale/query/save preservation before sync, then full raw-store equality through sync, CPU materialization and resync. Pin the original path independently; comparing two candidate paths would be insufficient.
Keep existing I16/bad-scale/F32/reused-snapshot fallbacks. Final source identity, actual native correctness and fresh complete-cycle evidence under the current1% policy remain separate prerequisites.
history_and_limits: This is D041's previously unimplemented hypothesis. D042's150.1862ms/9736.4349ms is a historical whole-U16-predicate optimistic1.5425% ceiling, not isolated q time or a promised saving. Remaining scale/snapshot and cache effects prevent a measured gain claim.
All current family arms leave arena.rs unchanged, but this review does not select or assume the final adopted baseline. No partial family outcomes were read.
